title: Connecting to a Multi-Chain RPC Gateway
summary: Best practices for dispatching JSON-RPC 2.0 requests across EVM networks using connection pooling and health checks.
prerequisites: npm install node-fetch or native fetch

steps.title: Configure Network Endpoint URLs
steps.description: Define base URLs for Ethereum and Base networks referencing server environment variables.

steps.title: Format JSON-RPC 2.0 Payload
steps.description: Construct standard JSON payload with jsonrpc: '2.0', id, method (e.g. eth_getBalance), and params array.

steps.title: Implement Timeout & Retry Wrapper
steps.description: Wrap fetch calls in an AbortController with a 4000ms timeout and exponential backoff retry.

commonProblems.cause: Creating new HTTP connections on every RPC call without pooling.
commonProblems.solution: Instantiate a persistent http.Agent with keepAlive: true.

title: Reading Wallet Token Balances on Ethereum & Base
summary: Step-by-step workflow for querying ERC-20 token holdings across Ethereum and Base simultaneously.

steps.title: Validate Target Address
steps.description: Confirm the user address matches standard 0x hex format.

steps.title: Query Multi-Chain Balances Concurrently
steps.description: Execute Promise.allSettled() querying Aster Wallet endpoints for both 'ethereum' and 'base'.

steps.title: Format Decimal Units
steps.description: Convert raw token balance strings using token decimals metadata.

commonProblems.cause: Converting large 18-decimal token wei integers to JavaScript Number primitives.
commonProblems.solution: Use BigInt or formatting libraries (e.g. ethers or viem formatUnits).

title: Real-Time Token Transfer Event Webhooks
summary: Configuring push notifications for ERC-20 transfers across Ethereum and Base using Orbit Gateway and Aster Protocol.
prerequisites: Public HTTPS domain or ngrok tunnel

steps.title: Create Inbound Webhook Listener Route
steps.description: Define POST /api/webhooks/transfers with express.raw middleware for HMAC validation.

steps.title: Register Subscription with API Provider
steps.description: Send POST request to Orbit/Aster registering the public webhook destination URL and target networks ['ethereum', 'base'].

steps.title: Handle Incoming Events Asynchronously
steps.description: Acknowledge HTTP 200 immediately, then forward payload to internal event processing worker.

commonProblems.cause: Destination server taking longer than 5000ms to process event and reply.
commonProblems.solution: Send res.status(200).send('OK') before initiating database writes.

title: Verifying Inbound Webhook HMAC Signatures
summary: Robust Node.js crypto recipe for verifying x-signature headers against the raw request buffer to prevent replay and spoofing attacks.

steps.title: Capture Raw Request Buffer
steps.description: Access req.body as Buffer before JSON.parse mutation.

steps.title: Compute HMAC-SHA256 Digest
steps.description: Use crypto.createHmac('sha256', SECRET).update(rawBuffer).digest('hex').

steps.title: Constant-Time Comparison
steps.description: Compare computed signature with header using crypto.timingSafeEqual() to prevent timing attacks.

title: Handling API Rate Limits & Exponential Backoff
summary: Defensive client-side architecture for managing provider rate limits (e.g. Northstar 10 RPS, Aster 25 RPS) with jittered backoff.

steps.title: Inspect HTTP 429 and Retry-After Header
steps.description: Read response status and parse Retry-After header if supplied.

steps.title: Calculate Jittered Backoff Delay
steps.description: Apply delay = Math.min(maxDelay, baseDelay * 2 ** attempt + Math.random() * 200).

steps.title: Implement Local Token Bucket
steps.description: Throttle outgoing requests on client before hitting the network.

title: Implementing Retry and Multi-Provider Failover Logic
summary: Building resilient fallback pipelines that switch between primary and secondary providers when errors or outages occur.

steps.title: Define Provider Fallback Hierarchy
steps.description: Establish primary candidate (e.g. Aster Wallet) and secondary candidate (e.g. Helios RPC).

steps.title: Detect Failover Triggers
steps.description: Trigger failover on 502/503/504 errors or consecutive timeouts.

steps.title: Circuit Breaker Implementation
steps.description: Temporarily demote failing provider for 60 seconds before probing health again.

title: Protecting API Credentials in Server-Side Architecture
summary: Ensuring private keys and provider tokens are confined strictly to Node.js / Express backend proxies without leaking to frontend Vite bundles.

steps.title: Audit Frontend Environment Variables
steps.description: Confirm that provider API keys DO NOT carry VITE_ prefixes.

steps.title: Build Backend Gateway Endpoint
steps.description: Create route /api/wallet/:address attaching Authorization: Bearer process.env.ASTER_API_KEY.

steps.title: Sanitize Outbound Responses
steps.description: Filter vendor response objects so internal tokens or debugging headers are never passed to the client.

steps.description: Define typed dictionary mapping chainId (1, 8453) to slug, name, and provider endpoint.

steps.title: Validate Active Chain Support
steps.description: Check if chosen provider lists target network in its supportedNetworks array.

title: Polling Fallback Architecture When Webhooks Are Unavailable
summary: How to structure an efficient polling loop for providers like Northstar Data that do not offer real-time push webhooks.

steps.title: Track High-Water Mark Block Number
steps.description: Store the last observed block number or transaction hash in local state.

steps.title: Schedule Interval Query with Safety Gap
steps.description: Poll every 12 seconds querying transactions where blockNumber > lastSeenBlock.

steps.title: Deduplicate Events
steps.description: Use a Set of transaction hashes to ignore duplicate items during re-orgs.
